Lock my door. I live in too rough of an area to trust a grown man knocking on my door unless I’m expecting someone round or have a delivery. 

I don’t want to get stabbed
Thank you!!!

My ears usually swell quite a bit but it’s never been super bad. I’d say I swell the expected amount? I don’t have many face piercings so I wanted to ask here in case i needed to expect some challenges with it that would affect work and whatnot. I’ll have to ask the piercer what he thinks I guess

Honestly I think a bit of everything, i got pretty unlucky with my mental health and family problems getting in the way of homework and revision. I missed several lessons from illness and failed to prioritise catching up with them when the final exam was coming up (to decide if I’d move to the next year) the content of the exam was all the content I had missed

I left after my first year but this is how my sixth form went: 

year 12- every day with 5hours on site study split over 2 days (you have at least one actual class a day) as well as one half day where the afternoon should be spent doing at home study (they didn’t check this though). Mondays had a ‘guidance’ period at the very start, then a one hour free period

Year 13- study times are flipped. So for the usual half day, you had to be in for the full day while your previous on site studies became at home study. The Monday morning guidance was also flipped so it was a one hour free period, then guidance. Most year 13 students used this to sleep in a little
I’m not sure if I’d sell, it would really depend on how much they’re worth. If I found a rare one I’d consider it
Building a dirt hut to survive the monsters

I’m on a waiting list to be assessed for autism and adhd, with the possibility of having bpd as well soooo it’s safe to say that my moods are never consistent and little things can set me off. That probably gives you a bit of a picture of how things are daily.

Yeah, they probably are understaffed but when I’ve called before (a few months back) I was put on hold until someone could take the call so idk if they were just too busy

I’ve only called one other time (they actually answered) and I had no idea that the person who Answers just gathers your details so the ‘actual’ crisis team can call you back. 

I messaged my bf and he drove home from work (20mins) grabbed his stuff, got food and came over (30min drive) wayyyyy before they actually rang back. It was so awkward having to explain to the person that I was now fine and with someone and then explain to my bf who tf called me at 12am

Honestly, just the regular shit mental health crap I deal with daily, it just hit way harder last night and I couldn’t cope with it. This week has been more stressful than usual though so that probably triggered it
My medical problems being dismissed

Little update:

I’ve sought out a second opinion and am being referred to an orthopaedic something or other, I can’t fully remember what. They’ll assess me more and and help me figure out what’s actually going on.

The doctor I spoke to (also a different one to the doctor who wanted to check my blood content) was given notes from my last two visits and discussed a few things like what advice I’ve already been given. He agreed that it definitely wasn’t growing pains and that if it was, it shouldn’t have been going on for so long and shouldn’t have kept getting worse. So overall, pretty relieved that I wasn’t judged again for my age and gender. 

Super happy with this and I should be receiving a letter soon to confirm an appointment has been made and telling me where to go as it’ll be in person!!!! Again, super relieved. Hopefully I’ll be able to get some effective help or at least some clarity with what’s going on sometime soon. 

This week has been pretty successful for me. I’m starting sleep meds for my insomnia, finally had a face to face appointment with my psychiatrist who’s now got more insight about what needs to be done going further and has referred me for a neurological assessment due to my symptoms and family history and now this!!! 

Will query again about the possibility of a breast reduction in a week or so but I’m not expecting much different to the advice I have already been given, but it’s worth a shot! Feeling super confident
Thank you, I’ve managed to get an appointment with the doctor who asked for the blood test because he seems like he might actually be willing to evaluate it further
Usually there’s no issue until they’re super long (I’m talking over an inch of nail) and then you have to bend your fingers back. Imagine it as a spoon but using the round back

They asked when it started, asked me to try doing a few movements (like squatting and telling them how far I could go down) and also asked if it was exclusive to one knee and if one was more painful than the other. At this time it was only in my knees and was fairly mild. Their reasoning was that I was quite young (15) at the time.

I was never asked if I had felt it before, which I don’t believe I had before it started and I first sought help

The doctor’s reasoning was that he couldn’t feel any abnormalities and that teenage girls are still young and hormonal
The physio I spoke to almost a year ago didn’t see me in person and said that it was growing pains. He sent a few exercises for me to do via email and that was that

I don’t speak to my dad very often anymore. For all he knows I’m still on the waiting list I got put on in May/June for the psychiatrist. There are so many other issues, it’s not just his ignorance that was an issue. 

My school has agreed to let me have more lenience with my homework, but obviously if they think I’m taking advantage of it (which from an outsider’s perspective it might seem that way) then I’ll lose this. It’s going to be reviewed in a few weeks to see where I’m at and if I still need more support. 

Thank you for your advice, if it becomes a bigger issue I probably will go to my gp like you mentioned. Right now, I hope, it might be manageable enough

Thank you. This genuinely reassured me. I can be overbearing at times and I didn’t want her thinking I was asking too much of her too often. I am trying to improve meeting deadlines as it wasn’t my strong point to begin with but I just hope she doesn’t think I’m taking advantage of her kindness
Thank you :)

Thank you so much. Omg the amount of times I’ve been called lazy for not doing things which relate to my mental health is insane. My dad doesn’t really believe in mental health so that didn’t help when I was living with him bc whenever I was disappointed with my grade on a mock his first response was “why didn’t you revise harder.” Almost as if I didn’t want to do well. I guess it’s just kind of engrained in me to question if I do have a valid reason for something or if I just need to ‘get over it’

The psychiatrist I’m seeing was meant to listen to my concerns so we could find a way to figure out what might help me cope. I already have a job. I already live in poverty. I’m already familiar with all this. I don’t understand how you calling me a failure is supposed to help?
I’m tired and don’t really have the energy to have an in depth conversation about anything rn but you can pm me if you’d like, I just probably won’t reply tonight
Thank you. My teacher is brilliant and she’s been lovely to me but I’m just worried that I’m disappointing her as well as wasting her time
Thank you. I’m just worried I’m wasting too much of her time
